description: Check whether an indicator (domain, URL, IP, CIDR, or file hash) appears in known malware, phishing, spam, or botnet feeds. Returns `total` (all matching records, not capped by `limit`) and `results`, one record per match: `value` (the matched indicator), `iocType` (IPv4, IPv6, URL, domain, hash, or CIDR), `threatType` (attack, botnet, C&C, malware, phishing, spam, suspicious, tor, or generic), and `firstSeen`/`lastSeen` dates. An empty `results` list means no feed record matched, not that the indicator is safe. Use this on every suspicious indicator before deeper enrichment — it's the cheapest gate. Do NOT use this for content-category labels like "gambling" or "adult" (use `categorization`) or for typosquat detection (use `typosquatting`).

limit.description: Maximum records per page. Max: 10,000. Every 100 records = 1 credit.

search_term.description: IoC to check: domain, URL, IP, CIDR, or hash. Supports wildcards for domains, URLs, IPs.

name: threat_intelligence
